dimensional_specification: DIN 965 countersunk cross-recess screws, H and Z profiles

material.name: Black oxide steel
material.note: Visual finish approximation; catalogue specifies colour only.

modelling_choices.catalogue_length: Unlisted lengths use the sourced size profile at the catalogue length and are explicitly marked as extensions.
modelling_choices.certification: Nominal catalogue geometry; not manufacturing certification.
modelling_choices.display: Smooth nominal thread envelope with the same head and recessed drive.
modelling_choices.head: Nominal dk with 90 degree cone and an adjusted positive rim within k max. Small tangent under-head radius is selected, not a manufacturer identification.
modelling_choices.markings: Unidentified manufacturer and property-class stamps omitted.
modelling_choices.recess: Published m and midpoint gauge penetration t select a nominal visual cavity. ISO 4757 wing width and taper guide a four-wing punch with a rounded centre and a conical floor; Z additionally has four shallow diagonal identification grooves. Die-flow radii and gauge conformity are not certified.
modelling_choices.runout: One-pitch taper; incomplete thread remains within 2P.
modelling_choices.thread: Nominal right-hand external metric profile; 60 degree flanks, H/6 rounded root; no ISO 965 tolerance offsets.
modelling_choices.thread_coverage: Full thread to the head as described by the Bossard products. Commercial lengths beyond the sheet are flagged.

sources.title: Bossard BN 388 Phillips DIN 965 A dimension table
sources.use: M2 to M6 head, H recess number, m, penetration limits and commercial lengths. DIN sizes are used without substitution of ISO head diameters.

sources.title: Bossard BN 3333 Pozidriv DIN 965 A dimension table
sources.use: Z recess number, m and penetration limits.

sources.title: Aspen Fasteners DIN 965 dimensional sheet
sources.use: M1.6 head and H recess dimensions. The M3.5 pitch misprint in this sheet is not used.

sources.title: ISO 4757:1983, clauses 2 and 3, H and Z dimension tables and sections
sources.use: Wing width f selected at the middle of the tolerance band, centre width b at its nominal value, outer wing slope 26 degrees 30 minutes, floor cone 28 degrees. Simplified visualization rather than a gauge-certified punch.

product.orientation: lying on side, head to left
product.support: Head rim and threaded shaft rest on ground; solve tilt from mesh.
